LIB-04 (ADR-0264 amendment 2026-10-09, #1108): after a shoulder press the ring is ON the chip row, on the segment the press selected - the row is one element, so its Left/Right step the same ring one console at a time, its Up leaves for the header and its Down returns to the grid it filters, and the footer names the shoulders and no Play (ADR-0256 Decision 6). The landing is skipped only where the sheet's own claim outranks it: while a restore is in flight (IsRestorePending / IsRestoreLanding) the ring lands on the remembered game, and the search box keeps the ring as it always did. FAIL if the ring does not reach the row outside those two. The row is not a named control the hook reads, so this is judged by eye. Record whether the ring on the row is obvious at couch distance. (manual: the chip row is not a named control and a fresh library has no console to step through)
